visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of several small, round, powder-coated cakes in paper liners, displayed outdoors on a stone surface with grass in the background. A hand reaches in to pick up a white cake topped with a yellow chestnut piece. (2) A purple cake is pulled apart by two hands, revealing a white cream interior with dark red jam oozing out. (3) A sequence of close-ups shows different colored cakes: a green one with jelly on top and a yellow one split to show orange filling. (4) The scene shifts to a kitchen where hands in blue gloves pipe light green cream onto a round cake base and add dollops of purple jam. (5) Cakes are shown being assembled, brushed with cream, and rolled in fine pink powder or brown meat floss. (6) Several gift boxes filled with colorful cakes are displayed. (7) Close-ups repeat the splitting of various cakes (pink, white, green, brown) to show their respective inner fillings. (8) The final shots show a bakery's display case filled with snacks, a menu board, and the exterior of a pink-themed shop with a sign reading 'Little Baby'.
